headline: Before: eleven rules 'not evaluable on any tick (0 of 3913)', and forced_slow 'clamped 3913 of 3913 (100.0%), mean delta +2.00 m/s' attributed to low_speed_uncongested -- a rule two lines above reported as never evaluable. After: all three arms read 'recommended speed raised on 0 of 3913 ticks; lowered on 0 of 3913', events={}. The 100% clamp rate produced by rules with no evidence is gone end to end.

predictions.note: Seven predictions were written BEFORE the fixes landed, in the session scratchpad, and all seven held, including two negative controls.
predictions.P6_target_lane_front_gap_line_qualified: held, and went further than asked

round_2_did_not_move_the_census: The census at dedd3c1 is byte-identical to the one at 89a1048, before round 2's forward_ttc and lane_changes_per_km evaluability refinements. Expected: every field those refinements branch on lacks evidence on this corpus, so they are forward-looking and change nothing measurable here. Stated because a reader comparing the two commits would otherwise wonder why a correctness fix moved no number.

structural_reachability.method: Build the observation with EVERY source marked measured and a fresh last_detection_age_s -- the most favourable input safety_inputs_from_observation can produce -- then ask which rules still have no field carrying evidence.

partly_reachable.forward_ttc: leader pair yes, merge-conflict pair no

structural_reachability.why: no rear sensor, no lane detection, no lane-change detector, no cooperating peers
structural_reachability.consequence: Seven of twelve rules cannot be evaluable on this rig whatever data is collected. That makes the census a confirmation of a structural fact rather than an observation about one corpus -- 'we saw none on 3,913 ticks' invites 'collect more data'; this does not. It is also why the lane advisory is withheld on every tick: three of its eight guards read fields the rig has no instrument for.

what_this_does_not_establish: Anything the gate would do in traffic. No rule was evaluable on any recorded tick, so the filter's behaviour under real evidence is unmeasured.
That the corpus is representative. It is four runs from one rig with a forward camera only.

The 1,229 'evaluable' ticks for target_lane_front_gap are not evidence: all are from the 2026-09-02 run, tagged derived beside a fallback_neutral leader_gap, a combination today's builder cannot produce, and the compared gap is inf on every one.
